title: [Peek] Enable reusable previewers for Peek to fix flicker

proposed_comments.title: (1/4) Capture the image item before dispatch
proposed_comments.body:
### (1/4) Capture the image item before dispatch

**Severity:** `medium`

The production dispatcher helper always queues through `TryEnqueue`, so this callback runs later. If copy starts on image A and the reusable previewer is rebound to B before the callback executes, reading mutable `Item` copies B. Capture `Item` before enqueueing and use that snapshot in the callback; apply all four members of this atomic group.

```suggestion
                var targetItem = Item;
                await Dispatcher.RunOnUiThread(async () =>
```

confidence.rationale: DispatcherExtensions.RunOnUiThread unconditionally calls TryEnqueue, while ImagePreviewer.Rebind replaces the mutable Item property. Capturing before enqueue removes that scheduling race.

proposed_comments.title: (2/4) Read the captured image item
proposed_comments.body:
### (2/4) Read the captured image item

**Severity:** `medium`

This callback must use the item captured before `RunOnUiThread` enqueues it. Otherwise an intervening `Rebind` changes the file copied from A to B. Apply this as part of the complete four-location atomic group.

```suggestion
                    var storageItem = await targetItem.GetStorageItemAsync();
```

confidence.rationale: The exact callback reads the current mutable Item after TryEnqueue; using the captured local makes the queued operation stable.

### (4/4) Read the captured unsupported-file item

**Severity:** `medium`

Use the item captured before `RunOnUIThreadAsync` schedules this callback. Reading `Item` inside it can select B after the operation began for A. Apply this as part of the complete four-location atomic group.

```suggestion
                var storageItem = await targetItem.GetStorageItemAsync();
```

confidence.rationale: The current queued callback dereferences Item after the dispatcher gap; the captured local prevents a copy of a later selection.
